title: Stock & deliveries
previousSlot: Carried over = the end count of {{slot}}
noPrevious: Some items have no end count from the previous shift. Please count the stock now first.

history.title: Change history
history.empty: Nothing recorded for this shift yet.

action.out: 📤 Record items sent to another store

form.inHelp: Enter only the items you received. Always count the contents yourself, even if the supplier tells you the number.
form.outHelp: Enter only the items you gave to another store.
form.openHelp: Enter the real count only for the items that do not match. Other items keep the previous shift’s count.
form.closeHelp: At the end of the shift, count what is left and fill in every item (0 if none). Usage is calculated automatically.
form.notePlaceholder: e.g. name of the person who brought it
form.noteOtherPlaceholder: e.g. Mr./Ms. … at the main store
form.noteRequired: For “other”, please write where it went.
form.enterAll: Enter a number for every item (0 if none).
form.negative: Some items have negative usage. Please count again.
form.unknownOpening: Usage cannot be calculated for items without a carry-over.
form.dateRange: You can record only yesterday’s, today’s or tomorrow’s shifts.
form.lossHelp: Enter only the items thrown away or damaged, and choose the reason. Add a photo if you have one.
form.photoHint: Photos / videos are optional (never film customers’ faces).
form.editHelp: Correct the figures {{name}} entered at {{time}}. The old row is cancelled and the person who corrected it is recorded.

temp.title: Fridge temperature
temp.help: Facing the fridges, enter from the left.
temp.enterAll: Enter the temperature of every fridge (e.g. 3, -18).

hint.momo: Chashu: 1 tray = 1 bag. Cooked meat: 3 pieces = 1 bag.
hint.moyashi: Even if the supplier tells you the number, always count the contents again.

item.seasoning: チャーシュー用調味料（Chashu seasoning）

reason.miscount: Previous shift miscounted / wrote it wrong
reason.unrecorded: A transfer or delivery was not recorded
reason.no_record: No record from the previous shift

photo.action: Read from a photo of the 日報
photo.title: Read from a photo of the 日報
photo.help: Take a photo of the filled 日報 (page 2): straight, bright, the whole sheet. The AI reads the numbers into a draft. Nothing is saved yet.
photo.readingHint: This takes about 20 seconds. Please stay on this screen.
photo.readFailed: Could not read it ({{error}}). Take it again or type the numbers.
photo.existing: This shift already has {{n}} records. The numbers from the photo are added to them (check that 受入 / 払出 are not counted twice).
photo.summary: To fix: {{red}} items · To check: {{amber}} items
photo.allOk: For every item, 繰越 + 受入 − 払出 − 差引 = 次シフト繰越.
photo.checkHelp: Compare with the paper and fix any wrong number. 🔴: fix it or tick "as on the paper"; 🟡: just check.
photo.confirmOk: This is what the paper says (checked)
photo.confirmRed: Fix the 🔴 items or tick "This is what the paper says": {{items}}
photo.noLeft: There is no 次シフト繰越 at all.
photo.reasonLabel: Why 繰越 differs from what the previous shift left
photo.reasonRequired: Choose why 繰越 differs from the previous shift.
photo.missingTitle: Items not on the photo (enter later)
photo.missingHelp: After saving, enter their 終わりの在庫 on the 在庫・仕入 screen.
photo.missingBanner: Some items have no 終わりの在庫 yet: {{items}}
photo.missingAction: Enter 終わりの在庫 for the other items
photo.tempsHint: From the left, facing the fridges. Not saved unless every fridge has a number.
photo.savedStandards: Saved. The different standard stock ({{n}} items) was sent to the system admin.

flag.sum: The sum does not match: 繰越 + 受入 − 払出 − 差引 = {{n}}{{unit}}, not the 次シフト繰越.
flag.carryPrev: Differs from what the previous shift left ({{n}}{{unit}}).
flag.unsure: Hard for the AI to read: {{fields}}
flag.leftMissing: 次シフト繰越 is empty.
